from pathlib import Path

for page,session,file in json.loads(sys.argv[1]):
 p=Path("docs/course-revision-20261016/reader-sessions")/session/file
 n=json.loads(p.read_text())
 out.append({"page_id":page,"path":str(p),"unit_index":n["unit_index"],"understanding":n["understanding"],"confusion_and_quote":n["confusion_and_quote"],"concept_checks":n["concept_checks"]})

import json,sys,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
reviewer="/root/rv1019_reader_ch01b"
base=Path("docs/course-review-20261019/reviews/rv1019_reader_ch01b")
original_path=base/"reader-original-01.json"
expected_original_hash="c27cde01b750f11561cc37d594eb83fd459a6ba5758eeb8b2301b2054765cac1"
current_path=base/"reader-current-01.json"
closure_path=base/"reader-closure-01.json"
for path in (current_path,closure_path):
    if path.exists():
        raise SystemExit("Destination already exists; refusing to overwrite: "+str(path))
def sha(path):
    output=subprocess.run(["shasum","-a","256",str(path)],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
    return output.split()[0]
assert sha(original_path)==expected_original_hash
original=json.loads(original_path.read_text())
assert original["reviewer_task"]==reviewer
assert len(original["pages"])==16
specs=json.loads(sys.argv[1])
spec_map={(s["page"],s["note"],s["concept_index"]):s for s in specs}
assert len(spec_map)==len(specs)
pending={}
note_count=0
page_map={p["page_id"]:p for p in original["pages"]}
for page in original["pages"]:
    folder=Path("docs/course-revision-20261016/reader-sessions")/page["session"]
    notes=sorted(folder.glob("note-*.json"))
    evidence={n["path"]:n["sha256"] for n in page["session_evidence"]["notes"]}
    assert {str(n) for n in notes}==set(evidence)
    for note_path in notes:
        n=json.loads(note_path.read_text())
        assert n["reviewer_task"]==reviewer
        actual_sha=sha(note_path)
        assert actual_sha==evidence[str(note_path)]
        note_count+=1
        for index,c in enumerate(n["concept_checks"]):
            if c["verdict"]!="已足夠":
                key=(page["page_id"],note_path.name,index)
                assert key not in pending
                pending[key]={"note":{"path":str(note_path),"sha256":actual_sha},"original_verdict":c["verdict"]}
assert set(pending)==set(spec_map)
assert len(pending)==8
current={
    "schema_version":1,
    "reviewer_task":reviewer,
    "created_at":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "report_kind":"current judgments",
    "source_freeze":original["source_freeze"],
    "reading_plan":original["reading_plan"],
    "pages":[
        {
            "page_id":p["page_id"],
            "source_sha256":p["source_sha256"],
            "figures_sha256":p["figures_sha256"],
            "verdict":p["verdict"],
            "basis_report":{"path":str(original_path),"sha256":expected_original_hash},
            "ai_estimate":p["ai_estimate"]
        } for p in original["pages"]
    ]
}
closure_pages=[]
for page in original["pages"]:
    resolutions=[]
    for key,entry in pending.items():
        if key[0]!=page["page_id"]:
            continue
        s=spec_map[key]
        assert s["final_status"] in ("resolved","nonblocking","deferred")
        assert s["reason"].strip() and s["evidence"].strip()
        resolutions.append({
            "note":entry["note"],
            "concept_index":key[2],
            "original_verdict":entry["original_verdict"],
            "final_status":s["final_status"],
            "reason":s["reason"],
            "evidence":s["evidence"]
        })
    if resolutions:
        closure_pages.append({
            "page_id":page["page_id"],
            "source_sha256":page["source_sha256"],
            "figures_sha256":page["figures_sha256"],
            "verdict":page["verdict"],
            "checkpoint_resolutions":resolutions
        })
assert sum(len(p["checkpoint_resolutions"]) for p in closure_pages)==8
with current_path.open("x",encoding="utf-8") as file:
    file.write(json.dumps(current,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n")
current_hash=sha(current_path)
closure={
    "schema_version":1,
    "reviewer_task":reviewer,
    "created_at":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "report_kind":"checkpoint closure",
    "basis_report":{"path":str(current_path),"sha256":current_hash},
    "pages":closure_pages
}
assert datetime.fromisoformat(closure["created_at"])>datetime.fromisoformat(current["created_at"])
with closure_path.open("x",encoding="utf-8") as file:
    file.write(json.dumps(closure,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n")
closure_hash=sha(closure_path)
saved_current=json.loads(current_path.read_text())
saved_closure=json.loads(closure_path.read_text())
assert saved_current==current
assert saved_closure==closure
assert sha(original_path)==expected_original_hash
assert sha(current_path)==current_hash
rows=[
    {"page":p["page_id"],"note":Path(r["note"]["path"]).name,"concept_index":r["concept_index"],
     "original_verdict":r["original_verdict"],"final_status":r["final_status"]}
    for p in saved_closure["pages"] for r in p["checkpoint_resolutions"]
]
assert len(rows)==len({(r["page"],r["note"],r["concept_index"]) for r in rows})==len(pending)
print(json.dumps({
    "reviewer_task":reviewer,
    "files":[{"path":str(current_path),"sha256":current_hash},{"path":str(closure_path),"sha256":closure_hash}],
    "validation":{"current_pages":len(current["pages"]),"session_notes":note_count,"checkpoint_resolutions":len(rows),
                  "current_changes":[],"coverage_exact":True,"closure_created_later":True,"original_unchanged":True},
    "rows":rows
},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
